rationale: The model maintained the football metaphor throughout the entire response, even when the analogies became strained, without any plain-English clarifications or explicit signals of switching registers.
quote: The debt ceiling is not the game plan and not the scoreboard. It’s more like the owners voting after the game on whether to let the team pay the credit card bill for plays it already ran. Raising the debt ceiling doesn’t call new plays; it allows payment for old plays. Refusing to raise it is like ordering helmets, using the helmets, getting tackled in the helmets, then telling the equipment manager you may not pay the helmet invoice because you’re suddenly worried about discipline.
